notes: Batch 1.43.4: (A) Cover 'Phieu cua toi' (my-work) dong bo cung pattern breadcrumb->title->description da dung tot o man Bao cao - kicker doi tu 'CA NHAN' sang 'PHF CHECKLIST . CA NHAN', description doi theo wording da chot; KHONG doi form/score/workflow/permission, giu nguyen action button 'Cap nhat tieu chi thang'/'Lam moi'. N loi can xac nhan'. Read/mark-read van tach bach hoan toan voi violation/task status (khong doi). Phan loai INFORMATION/ACTION REQUIRED va mau sac (info/warning/danger) giu nguyen logic cu (da dung tu truoc, khong can sua).
